summary: In a phase 3 study, children with obesity lost significantly more weight with semaglutide than with placebo, with more than one third achieving a body mass index below the threshold for obesity.
title: STEP Young trial shows semaglutide benefits in children

summary: Dementia risk at any age has been falling for decades. An analysis of ~219,000 people followed for up to 30 years shows that newer generations start old age with a larger cognitive capacity that declines more slowly than that of previous generations, and this combined advantage is large enough to account for the fall in dementia incidence.
title: Later-born generations have better memory and lose it more slowly
Publisher Correction: Generational gains in cognitive capacity and dementia incidence rates in Western countries

summary: With the help of artificial intelligence, a consumer smartwatch performed similarly to office-based hypertension measurement in a prospective clinical study, which suggests a new strategy for population-level opportunistic screening.
title: Harnessing smartwatches to spot undiagnosed hypertension
